text: Review authority is accepted even when review.commit_id differs from the current PR head SHA.
Merge readiness returns success when no authenticated exact-head review authority exists.
After the reviewer acknowledgement deadline expires, the same provider is retried forever and no fallback is selected.
The trusted collector dispatches another Actions workflow but its permissions contain actions: read.
A current exact-head authenticated review is required; waiting reviewers remain pending and blocking findings remain failure.
